description: Controlled pathways for tracing latent signals from early manifestation through system stress, escalation, consequences and potential intervention windows.

legend.evidence_linked: Mapping supported by explicit domain, manifestation, impact or risk evidence in the record.
legend.heuristic: Mapping suggested by title/summary/root-cause language and should be reviewed.
legend.no_observation: No sufficient evidence is currently mapped to this node; this does not mean the node is absent in reality.

cross_system_cascade.label: Cross-System Cascade
cross_system_cascade.description: A generic cascade showing how a localized latent signal can propagate from environmental or societal stress into systemic vulnerability.

nodes.label: Latent Signal
nodes.description: An early anomaly, weak warning or creeping change detected before a confirmed crisis.

nodes.label: System Stress
nodes.description: The anomaly begins to place measurable pressure on an ecological, physical or social system.

nodes.label: Critical Resource Pressure
nodes.description: A critical resource or system function becomes constrained enough to affect dependent activities.

nodes.label: Livelihood Disruption
nodes.description: Production, income, access or routine livelihood activities become disrupted by the preceding pressure.

nodes.label: Social Pressure
nodes.description: The disruption creates pressure on communities, behavior, migration, access or social cohesion.

nodes.label: Institutional Strain
nodes.description: Existing institutions, services or response systems face increasing difficulty absorbing the signal.

nodes.label: Systemic Vulnerability
nodes.description: Multiple dependencies become exposed, increasing the chance of wider cascading impacts.

nodes.label: Intervention Window
nodes.description: A potential point for monitoring, prevention, mitigation or resilience-building. This node is an analytical response point, not an observed event.

water_system.label: Water System
water_system.description: A source-to-use pathway tracing latent water signals through quality, quantity and access pressures.

ocean_coastal_system.label: Ocean & Coastal System
ocean_coastal_system.description: A coastal cascade linking marine observations to habitat, fisheries and community effects.

climate_ecosystem_system.label: Climate & Ecosystem System
climate_ecosystem_system.description: A pathway for climate anomalies moving through ecological stress and dependent human systems.

biodiversity_system.label: Biodiversity System
biodiversity_system.description: A pathway connecting species-level anomaly to population, ecosystem function and service loss.

disaster_risk_system.label: Disaster Risk System
disaster_risk_system.description: A precursor-to-impact pathway for disaster risk reduction, including exposure and response capacity.

social_behavioral_system.label: Social & Behavioral System
social_behavioral_system.description: A social pathway linking behavioral observations to resource pressure, institutional strain and community resilience.

technology_digital_system.label: Technology & Digital Transformation
technology_digital_system.description: A pathway linking emerging technology signals to dependency, data or algorithmic pressure, service disruption and digital inclusion risks.

nodes.label: Technology Signal
nodes.description: An emerging technological change, unusual digital dependency or early warning involving AI, platforms, data or connected systems.

nodes.label: Digital Dependency Pressure
nodes.description: Critical services, institutions or communities become increasingly dependent on a digital system, platform or technology.

nodes.label: Data & Algorithmic Risk
nodes.description: Data quality, algorithmic behavior, privacy, cyber exposure or automated decision processes introduce systemic pressure.

nodes.label: Digital Service Disruption
nodes.description: Digital failures or harmful technology effects disrupt access to services, information, markets or public functions.

nodes.label: Digital & Social Impact
nodes.description: Digital disruption or unequal access affects livelihoods, participation, trust, safety or social inclusion.

nodes.label: Intervention Window
nodes.description: A potential point for responsible technology governance, resilience-building, digital inclusion, risk monitoring or capacity development.

governance_institutional_system.label: Governance & Institutional System
governance_institutional_system.description: A pathway tracing policy and governance signals through implementation friction, institutional strain, service gaps and potential response points.

nodes.label: Governance Signal
nodes.description: An emerging policy, regulatory, institutional or governance anomaly that may weaken system resilience.

nodes.label: Policy & Regulatory Gap
nodes.description: Existing rules, standards, mandates or policy instruments do not adequately address the emerging condition.

nodes.label: Implementation Friction
nodes.description: Capacity, coordination, incentives or institutional processes constrain implementation even when policy direction exists.

nodes.label: Institutional Strain
nodes.description: Institutions or public services face increasing difficulty absorbing, coordinating or responding to the emerging pressure.

nodes.label: Service & Resilience Gap
nodes.description: Weak governance or institutional capacity produces uneven service delivery, reduced resilience or exposed communities.

nodes.label: Intervention Window
nodes.description: A potential point for policy review, institutional strengthening, coordination, monitoring, implementation support or governance reform.

livelihood_food_system.label: Livelihood & Food System
livelihood_food_system.description: A pathway connecting environmental or economic signals to production stress, food-system pressure, livelihood disruption and household or community resilience.

nodes.label: Livelihood & Food Signal
nodes.description: An early signal involving food availability, production, income, fisheries, farming or livelihood security.

nodes.label: Production & Resource Stress
nodes.description: Environmental, resource or economic pressures reduce the stability or productivity of food and livelihood systems.

nodes.label: Food Supply Pressure
nodes.description: Production stress begins to affect availability, prices, distribution or reliability of food resources.

nodes.label: Livelihood Disruption
nodes.description: Households or producer groups experience reduced income, employment, production or access to essential livelihood resources.

nodes.label: Household & Community Pressure
nodes.description: Sustained livelihood or food pressure affects household coping capacity, migration, social cohesion or local wellbeing.

nodes.label: Intervention Window
nodes.description: A potential point for adaptation, livelihood diversification, social protection, food-system resilience, market monitoring or capacity support.
